doc: human-reactions stations: the reaction line, four standing human dummies 2.5 m apart in the hub (x 6..13.5, y 2.5) that never die, so every hit plays a wound family on its cast rig (run the arena with --rigs): walk around one and shoot it from the front, behind and both sides to see the flinch follow the round. The standard deaths play in the pit (enemy_pit / arena_pit), where hits kill. Dev scene with every family and death on patrol, riot and pedestrian rigs: res://dev/human_react/react_board_run.gd.

stations.doc: Four human dummies in a line: shoot or claw each from four sides; the reaction follows the hit (flinch for light rounds, stagger for heavy, spin or fold for melee, stun for the shock).
stations.name: Reaction line
